notes:
Real tire recommendations, a full Race History screen, and rival flag alerts.

Added:
- Race History now shows pit stops (tires changed, duration) and lap-by-lap detail per session, plus click-to-sort columns - Laps, Fuel, Best lap etc. sort by real value, not alphabetically.
- Tire Strategy now recommends a real tire change (or "no change") based on your own recorded pit-stop and stint history for that car/track - starts showing up once you've raced a car/track combo enough times to build a real sample.
- A "track's nearly dry, switch to slicks at your next stop" advisory, for when conditions cross back from wet toward dry mid-race.
- A notification when the car directly ahead or behind you gets a black flag, is disqualified, or is called in for mandatory repair.
- The overlay can now be pinned (small pin icon next to the close button) so it stays up instead of auto-hiding once the condition that triggered it resolves.

Fixed:
- Session duration in History almost always showed "-" instead of the real elapsed time.
- The track-drying advisory could permanently miss the wet-to-dry transition if it happened to land on a lap where you were in the pits for something unrelated.
- Closing the app could fail to save a session's real end time, if the window closed while the telemetry loop's own cleanup was still running.
